scope: Actual single-photo ROI/alpha preparation, classical inpainting, motion-footprint budgeting and rendered layered video.

coverage: Default preserves real alpha openings and disconnected structures; explicit cleanup is configurable.
CLI seed arguments execute real GrabCut.
Output hardlink aliases cannot overwrite the supplied alpha.
Rejected overwrite preserves a previous complete layer bundle.
Strict motion rejects unsupported exposure without exporting pretend assets.
Non-strict motion reduction is explicit and passes complete working-resolution exposure checks.
New ROI GrabCut assets are generated without preexisting layers.
Known-ground-truth background pixels improve after actual inpainting.

synthetic_ground_truth.fixture: Procedurally generated 480x270 gradient background and opaque red rectangle; see tests/test_motion_layers.py.
synthetic_ground_truth.interpretation: This simple gradient verifies real repair and color-ghost removal; it does not establish quality on complex photographic holes.

fresh_user_photo.provenance: Existing user-supplied photo; newly converted via macOS sips to opaque 8-bit JPEG for this run. No old layer assets or masks used.

segmentation.limitations: Color/texture separation needs user supervision; this is not semantic segmentation or a video mask tracker.

cleanup.note: Cleanup is explicit; default preserves disconnected components and real openings.

budget_limits.interpretation: Geometric limits for classical inpainting; not a semantic completion-quality guarantee.

qa.note: Texture statistics are diagnostics, not proof of realistic completion. Inspect the contact sheet and rendered motion.

visual_review.reviewer: Implementation agent, contact sheets from actual H.264 decoded frames plus generated-asset QA sheet.
observed: Foreground flag silhouette is complete at the inspected first, middle and final frames.
Foreground enlarges faster than the wall and shifts right; full requested strength retained.
No exposed empty band or obvious red/blue color ghost in the inspected visible repair strips.
The large inpainted hidden core is visibly poor and explicitly marked untrusted; it remains behind the foreground during this motion.
visual_review.scope: Limited 2.5D illustration only. Manual sequence review remains required before publication; not actual depth or reconstructed hidden wall.

artifacts.storage: Validation-run outputs; selected files may be copied into the repository proof gallery by its maintainer.

discarded_photo_probe.reason: Sparse ROI GrabCut mislabeled broad gradient-sky regions as foreground; visual alpha review failed. Not used as a showcase proof. No general semantic-segmentation ability is claimed.

safety_and_quality_boundaries: Every candidate motion is tested at working-source resolution over every output frame; coarse resampling is diagnostic only because narrow known openings can disappear.
Required source footprint is expanded for interpolation support. Manifest records full-resolution budget, all attempts, approved actual motion and explicit reductions.
Telea/NS removes the full occluder for valid known-background context; only the required exposed band is certified for the approved motion. Hidden core is not scene reconstruction.
Preparation checks opaque uint8 RGB input and HDR tags when FFmpeg is available; absence of HDR metadata is not proof of an intended SDR transfer.
No learned segmentation/depth/inpainting model, 3D recovery, video segmentation or temporal background synthesis is used.
Bundle publication uses shared staging and rollback; output aliases, unsupported symlinks and rejected replacement over existing assets are protected.
